description: This file is a Markdown document describing the 'Route' class and its methods in the Playwright networking API, including routing, aborting, continuing, fallback, fetch, and fulfill functionalities, with usage examples and parameter details.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Represents a network route that allows to handle, modify, or abort network requests.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts the route's request with an optional error code.

methods.name: continue
methods.description: Resumes the route's request to the network with optional overrides for URL, method, headers, and post data.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Continues the route's request with optional modifications, allowing other route handlers to process it.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Performs the request, fetches the response without fulfilling it, allowing response modifications before fulfillment.

methods.name: fulfill
methods.description: Fulfills the route's request with a specified response, including status, headers, body, or a file path.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Returns the Request object associated with this route.
